description: This file is a shell script designed to automate the restart process for the OpenClaw application. It includes steps to kill existing instances, rebuild the app, handle code signing, package the app, install necessary launch agents, and relaunch the application while verifying its status.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a message to the log.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: run_step
methods.description: Logs a step label and executes a command, failing if the command fails.

methods.name: acquire_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent concurrent restarts.

methods.name: check_signing_keys
methods.description: Checks for available code signing identities.

methods.name: choose_app_bundle
methods.description: Selects or verifies the application bundle to restart.

methods.name: stop_launch_agent
methods.description: Stops the launch agent related to OpenClaw.
